title: Prepositions of Time and Place
explanation: Prepositions show the relationship between words. For time: AT for specific times (at 3pm, at night), ON for days/dates (on Monday, on July 4th), IN for longer periods (in January, in 2024, in the morning). For place: AT for specific points (at the door), ON for surfaces (on the table), IN for enclosed spaces (in the room).
examples: I wake up at 7am every day.
We go on vacation in August.
She's waiting at the bus stop.
The book is on the shelf.
